business_summary.text: The New India Assurance Company Limited is India's largest multinational general insurance company, identified as a domestic systematically important insurer by IRDAI.

call_points.text: Management expects double-digit growth for the entire book in FY27, driven by retail segments.
Motor segment growth is guided to be in single digits as the company focuses on profitability.
Wage revision and family pension impact of ₹3,525 Cr was fully absorbed in FY26.
Health segment contributed 66% of overall growth in FY26, followed by Fire at 25%.
Health segment ICR improved by 2% due to increased monitoring and TPA audits.
IT infrastructure revamp is nearing completion to support digital marketing and sales.
Capital gains for the year amounted to ₹5,477 Cr.
Motor TP ICR worsened to 113.86% as premium rates remained stagnant while court awards increased.

timeline.summary: New India Assurance received ₹612.34 Cr tax refund including ₹180.52 Cr interest for AY 2014-15 and 2017-18
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹10,021.77 Cr, net profit ₹564.16 Cr.
The New India Assurance reported FY26 GWP of ₹47,174 Cr and PAT of ₹1,384 Cr, with market share rising to 12.74%.
Abhishek Pagaria digitally signed the concall recording link for the Investor/Analyst Meet held on 14.05.2026, available at www.newindia.co.in.
The New India Assurance received an income tax refund of ₹255.68 Cr for AY 2019-20.
The New India Assurance reported FY26 PAT growth of 40% to ₹1,384 Cr and a market share increase to 12.74% during its Q4FY26 earnings call.
Q1FY27 (Jul 2026): GWP rose 2.9% to ₹13,720 Cr but the combined ratio worsened to 121.44% and PAT swung to a ₹257 Cr loss from ₹391 Cr profit.
The New India Assurance reported Q2FY27 consolidated gross premium of ₹11,083 Cr and a net loss of ₹1,267 Cr.
The New India Assurance reported Q2FY27 consolidated gross written premium of ₹11,083.43 Cr and a net loss of ₹1,267.04 Cr.
